# SNS Enterprise

> SNS Enterprise is a distribution company based in Kathmandu, Nepal, supplying grocery and household products to retailers and bulk buyers. Products made in Nepal are sourced directly from the manufacturer; international products are supplied through the distributor officially appointed by the original manufacturer.

Address: Hariyo Pool, Kathmandu, Bagmati Province 44600, Nepal

## Products
Buldak noodles, cup noodles, Mentos, dish soap, washing machine detergent, Joyner juice, coconut drink, and similar grocery/household items. Full list: /products.html
